title: Does Ecosystem Activity Validate TVL?
abstract: arXiv:2610.36274v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Total value locked (TVL) is widely used to assess decentralized finance ecosystems. Prior evidence finds that portfolios formed on TVL alone are spanned by the crypto market portfolio (Brigida 2025). This paper asks whether TVL becomes more informative when combined with measures of adoption, usage, development, protocol revenue, or social attention. I construct weekly value-weighted 2x3 portfolios that independently sort tokens on TVL-to-market-cap and one of seven ecosystem-activity ratios. Portfolio returns are computed from token prices using lagged-market-capitalization weights and evaluated against crypto market and size factors. Across the available 2022-2025 samples, none of the six on-chain double sorts rejects the benchmark after controlling for multiple testing. The same conclusion holds over 83 common weeks for which social-attention data are available. Several specifications reject at unadjusted levels, but none survives Hol

translated_title: 生态系统活动能否验证TVL（总锁定价值）？
translated_abstract: 总锁定价值（TVL）被广泛用于评估去中心化金融生态系统。此前的研究发现，仅基于TVL构建的投资组合会被加密货币市场投资组合所覆盖（Brigida 2025）。本文探讨当TVL与采用率、使用率、开发活动、协议收入或社交关注度等指标相结合时，是否会变得更具信息量。作者构建了周度价值加权的2x3投资组合，独立地按照TVL与市值之比以及七种生态系统活动比率之一对代币进行双重排序。投资组合收益率使用滞后市值权重从代币价格计算得出，并针对加密货币市场因子和规模因子进行评估。在可用的2022-2025年样本中，在经过多重检验校正后，六个链上双重排序组合均无法拒绝市场基准假设。在拥有社交关注度数据的83个共同周内也得出了相同的结论。部分规格在未校正的显著性水平上拒绝了原假设，但没有一个能通过Holm多重检验校正。
tldr: 研究表明，将TVL与生态系统活动指标（如采用率、使用率、开发活动、协议收入和社交关注度）相结合，在经过多重检验校正后仍无法产生超越加密货币市场基准的超额收益，说明TVL本身不包含市场投资组合之外的定价信息。
en_tdlr: After multiple-testing corrections, double-sorting tokens on TVL-to-market-cap and seven ecosystem-activity ratios yields no portfolios that beat crypto market and size benchmarks, showing TVL contains no pricing information beyond the market portfolio.
